title: Frequency Domain ↔ Perspective Shift
idiom: scientific woodcut with a Fourier-era engraving style — dual panels, one showing a waveform oscillating in time, the other showing frequency spikes, joined by a transformation arrow, evoking 18th-century scientific illustration
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop, a scientific woodcut engraving in the style of 18th-century natural philosophy illustration: two side-by-side panels separated by a bold transformation arrow. Left panel — a time-domain waveform, sinuous and cresting, amplitude over time rendered as an engraved line. Right panel — frequency-domain spikes rising from a baseline, sharp and vertical, the same signal made visible in a different coordinate system. The arrow between them glows faintly, suggesting mathematical transformation, not magic. Figures studying the two panels are silhouetted at the bottom — one woman, one man, balanced. Monochrome engraving aesthetic with aged paper tone. No letters, numerals, words, labels, or text of any kind — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem: a thick double-headed arrow pointing left and right, with a sinuous waveform on the left and a set of three vertical frequency spikes on the right. The arrow is the visual anchor — wide, geometric, unmistakable at 24px. Deep navy background, white linework only, no fine detail, no text, no letters, no numerals — purely a symbol of two-way transformation.
